parameters.pythonCode: # Loop over input items and add a new field called 'myNewField' to the JSON of each one def add_link_to_order_name(order_id, order_name): return f"""{order_name}""" def wrap_tr(string_to_wrap): return "" + str(string_to_wrap or "") + "" def wrap_td(string_to_wrap): return "" + str(string_to_wrap or "") + "" html_table = "" for item in _input.all(): html_line = "" html_line += wrap_td(add_link_to_order_name(item.json.id, item.json.order_name)) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.risk_level) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.order_value_check) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.release_order_status) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.failed_reason) html_table += wrap_tr(html_line) _input.last().json.html_table = html_table return _input.last()

risk_level_count = {
  "LOW": 0,
  "MEDIUM": 0,
  "HIGH": 0
}

pick_list_status_count = {
  "Not Processed": 0,
  "Created": 0,
  "Not Created": 0
}

release_order_status_count = {
  "Not Processed": 0,
  "Released": 0,
  "Not Released": 0
}

order_value_check_count = {
  "Not Processed": 0,
  "Passed": 0,
  "Failed": 0
}

all_check_count = {
  "Not Processed": 0,
  "Passed": 0,
  "Failed": 0
}

order_number = 0

for item in _input.all():
  if 'risk_level' not in item.json:
    break
  order_number += 1
  risk_level_count[item.json.risk_level] += 1
  release_order_status_count[item.json.release_order_status] += 1
  pick_list_status_count[item.json.pick_list_status] += 1
  order_value_check_count[item.json.order_value_check] += 1
  all_check_count[item.json.all_check] += 1

_input.last().json.order_number = order_number
_input.last().json.processed_order_number = risk_level_count["LOW"]
_input.last().json.medium_to_high_risk_order_number = risk_level_count["MEDIUM"] + risk_level_count["HIGH"]
_input.last().json.all_check_failed_number = all_check_count["Failed"]
_input.last().json.order_value_check_failed_number = order_value_check_count["Failed"]
_input.last().json.creating_list_failed_number = pick_list_status_count["Not Created"]
_input.last().json.released_failed_number = release_order_status_count["Not Released"]
_input.last().json.released_number = release_order_status_count["Released"]

return _input.last()
